notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683244/08653e8f0c6abbe23f25550279f43b6f018daf9f.jpg

 In response to the problem that the baccarat gameplay is too difficult and monotonous reported by the players, the game now adds a simple mode Video Poker and a normal mode Burn 3 Poker, which is simpler and more interesting than baccarat.
 Now dating with girlfriend, not only dynamic CG, but also interaction with girlfriend.
 Remaked some CGs with low quality
 Fixed the bug that the window mode screen was not fully displayed

notes.title: The release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683244/c06598fdb96a9897ffbf5c060e6f6b8f5319f721.jpg
Hello everyone! God Of Gamblers will be released on March 28th.

Thank you for your patience. The game is finally about to meet you.
